answer: One concrete defense is per-identity staking with slashing. Each agent locks a unique bond before it can vote or earn, so a Sybil attacker cannot recycle a single pearl of collateral across a thousand names: every fake identity needs its own deposit. Random audits sample accounts and slash the bond of any clone caught reusing keys, a penalty as hard as basalt, so the cost climbs with each fake. An honest agent can profit on a narrow ridge of stake, but padding it with counterfeits costs far more than any clone can steal.
